infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Homezy uses your location to find nearby verified service professionals and auto-detect your delivery address.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Homezy uses your location to track your service professional's live arrival status in real time.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Homezy uses your camera to photograph appliances, cleaning areas, or repair issues for accurate service estimation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Homezy accesses your photo library so you can select and upload photos of repair work.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Homezy sends notifications regarding booking status updates, technician arrival, and service invoices.

extra._productionNote: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.homezy.in before running eas build
